risks.risk: machine denominator incomplete
risks.trigger: D0-D8 final leaves are absent or unclassified
risks.mitigation: exact-source extractors, reviewed leaf mapping and zero-unclassified SG1
risks.contingency: stop broad implementation and keep all compatibility claims false

risks.risk: target repository has no exact-head native CI evidence
risks.trigger: workflow run collection is empty for the current head
risks.mitigation: enable Actions and require a stable aggregate merge gate
risks.contingency: block merge/promotion; relay evidence remains no-credit until target validation

risks.risk: main can accept unreviewed or unchecked changes
risks.trigger: main protection/rulesets/required checks are disabled
risks.mitigation: activate ruleset, latest-head checks, independent review and CODEOWNERS
risks.contingency: treat main as unverified integration storage and prohibit releases

risks.risk: multiple incompatible schema families become competing authorities
risks.trigger: runtime, CI or operators consume both migrations/ and database/schema/v2
risks.mitigation: bind one production schema authority and validate forbidden consumers
risks.contingency: stop migrations and restore the last reviewed authoritative digest

risks.risk: upstream drift makes the chosen release baseline obsolete
risks.trigger: mandatory upstream delta backlog exceeds one release train
risks.mitigation: independent delta lane and SG7 final baseline freeze
risks.contingency: delay release or publish an explicitly scoped baseline

risks.risk: JavaScript engine semantic incompatibility
risks.trigger: representative Goja corpus has unexplained P0/P1 gaps
risks.mitigation: early engine bake-off, immutable corpus and ADR
risks.contingency: select a different audited engine/profile or keep C5 open

risks.risk: Lua engine semantic incompatibility
risks.trigger: GopherLua corpus has unexplained P0/P1 gaps
risks.mitigation: early engine bake-off, immutable corpus and ADR
risks.contingency: select a different audited engine/profile or keep C5 open

risks.risk: runtime sandbox escape or unbounded resource use
risks.trigger: capability, fuel, memory, deadline or filesystem/network isolation bypass
risks.mitigation: capability host, process isolation where needed, fuzzing and security review
risks.contingency: disable affected runtime profile and drain modules

risks.risk: stale owner accepts writes or ghost presence persists
risks.trigger: node loss, partition or lease expiry creates duplicate authority/route
risks.mitigation: generation fencing, bounded leases, reconnect contracts and chaos tests
risks.contingency: fail closed, remove readiness and drain the cohort

risks.risk: PostgreSQL transaction or schema semantics diverge
risks.trigger: OCC, ordering, retry, constraint, backup or restore differential
risks.mitigation: authoritative migration digest, model tests and fault matrix
risks.contingency: block the profile and retain Nakama authority

risks.risk: CockroachDB behavior differs materially from PostgreSQL or assumptions
risks.trigger: transaction restart, leaseholder, index, lock or failover divergence
risks.mitigation: independent profile, query/fault/backup evidence
risks.contingency: defer CockroachDB support without weakening PostgreSQL conclusions

risks.risk: IAP ambiguous outcome duplicates or loses value
risks.trigger: provider success with uncertain local transaction/effect state
risks.mitigation: stable identity, transactional outbox, receipt reconciliation and quarantine
risks.contingency: disable provider and manually reconcile the quarantined transaction

risks.risk: provider API, key or sandbox changes invalidate the adapter
risks.trigger: provider fixture, endpoint, algorithm or policy changes
risks.mitigation: versioned adapters, key-cache rules, monitored fixtures and delta lane
risks.contingency: disable the provider with an explicit status

risks.risk: password, refresh or revocation migration allows replay
risks.trigger: one refresh family is writable or accepted by two authorities
risks.mitigation: authority matrix, atomic family rotation/replay revoke and key retirement
risks.contingency: force reauthentication and revoke affected families/epochs

risks.risk: Console RBAC or dangerous-action bypass
risks.trigger: unauthorized or unapproved operator mutation
risks.mitigation: MFA, RBAC, dual approval, audit and negative permission matrix
risks.contingency: disable mutation endpoints and revoke operator sessions

risks.risk: scope and evidence cost exceed funding
risks.trigger: SG1/SG3 P80 or required specialist staffing exceeds the resource envelope
risks.mitigation: P50/P80, earned denominator coverage and actual-cost reporting
risks.contingency: increase budget, extend schedule or ADR-scope a separate version without false full-parity claims

risks.risk: CDC lag or final delta loses writes
risks.trigger: source sequence gap, receipt mismatch or write-fence escape
risks.mitigation: checkpointed backfill, semantic verification and write fence
risks.contingency: abort cutover and retain source primary

risks.risk: normalizer hides a true incompatibility
risks.trigger: identity, ACL, order, money, version, cursor, error or durable effect is normalized
risks.mitigation: denylist registry and independent normalizer review
risks.contingency: revoke the evidence and reopen all dependent gates

risks.risk: fixtures or evidence expose PII, tokens, receipts or secrets
risks.trigger: a disallowed field enters logs/artifacts
risks.mitigation: allowlist sanitization, irreversible pseudonymization and secret/privacy scanning
risks.contingency: revoke artifact, rotate secrets and execute incident notification

risks.risk: runtime, realtime, migration or security staffing is unavailable
risks.trigger: critical role or reviewer vacancy exceeds 60 days
risks.mitigation: early hiring, paired ownership and partner plan
risks.contingency: resequence noncritical work and keep gates open

risks.risk: supply-chain compromise
risks.trigger: unverified dependency, action, image, generator or artifact
risks.mitigation: immutable pins, lockfiles, SBOM, provenance, signing and review
risks.contingency: freeze release and rebuild from a clean trusted environment

risks.risk: rollback routes traffic to stale data
risks.trigger: Rust-only writes/effects are not reconciled before authority reversal
risks.mitigation: rollback barrier, reverse delta or proof of no new writes
risks.contingency: stop affected service rather than lose or duplicate data

risks.risk: native dependency, FFI or unsafe code expands attack surface
risks.trigger: new unsafe block, VM, crypto or native parser dependency
risks.mitigation: unsafe budget, ADR, isolation, fuzzing and audit
risks.contingency: replace dependency or isolate the component process

risks.risk: evidence becomes stale, incomplete or nonreproducible
risks.trigger: artifact targets an older commit, lacks tree/review or environment changed
risks.mitigation: evidence index, expiry, exact locks and rerun policy
risks.contingency: remove claim credit and reopen dependent gates

risks.risk: task estimates omit cross-functional effort
risks.trigger: three consecutive forecast overruns or missing review/environment work
risks.mitigation: actual-vs-estimate review and P80 update
risks.contingency: replan the critical path

risks.risk: repository name or wording implies official endorsement or unsupported replacement
risks.trigger: public metadata uses official/drop-in/production language beyond evidence
risks.mitigation: NOTICE/trademark/claim review and derived release status
risks.contingency: revise claims or product naming

risks.risk: isolated scale targets waste cost or miss the real workload
risks.trigger: benchmark lacks an approved profile, oracle or cost model
risks.mitigation: profile-based SLO, confidence intervals and cost baselines
risks.contingency: invalidate benchmark credit

risks.risk: private cryptographic primitives contain subtle correctness or side-channel defects
risks.trigger: confirmed length truncation or new cross-vector/fuzz mismatch
risks.mitigation: reviewed library or independent adapter audit, vectors and fuzzing
risks.contingency: disable the adapter/profile and revoke affected keys/sessions if exposed

risks.risk: security-critical crates are omitted from the root mandatory gate
risks.trigger: root workspace/test command completes without compiling the JWT adapter
risks.mitigation: explicit aggregate security-critical lane and later workspace consolidation
risks.contingency: block merge whenever the lane is missing

risks.risk: horizontal library growth hides missing end-to-end server integration
risks.trigger: more domain cores land while no Rust binary accepts and durably completes one request
risks.mitigation: blocker-first Rust vertical slice milestone
risks.contingency: pause broad feature expansion

risks.risk: live tests silently skip and are mistaken for verification
risks.trigger: required database environment is absent but the test returns success
risks.mitigation: explicit required-live flag, assertion accounting and no-credit developer skips
risks.contingency: invalidate affected evidence and rerun

risks.risk: external relay becomes a substitute for target-repository authority
risks.trigger: relay result is accepted without exact target commit/tree and target-native validation
risks.mitigation: evidence index and aggregate target validator
risks.contingency: remove relay claim credit while retaining artifacts as diagnostics

risks.risk: stale integration PR or duplicate branches create competing source authority
risks.trigger: PR body candidate differs from head or many equivalent refs remain active
risks.mitigation: one active integration line and approved branch disposition manifest
risks.contingency: convert stale PR to draft/close and preserve immutable archive refs

risks.risk: independent review cannot be satisfied by the current ownership map
risks.trigger: security/database/protocol evidence has only the implementer as owner/reviewer
risks.mitigation: assign named independent users/teams and enforce CODEOWNERS/ruleset review
risks.contingency: keep dependent gaps and gates open

summary.rule: Summary is validated and must be regenerated when risk statuses change.
